cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Still a Good Sign
cards.instruction: Treat every awkward or disappointing interaction as proof that the connection remains alive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've set my menu aside like you. Our first dinner since the breakup, and we're choosing together already.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine's sticky. I want a clean menu, not a reunion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, a clean start. You still tell me exactly what you need; we haven't lost that.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need to eat without you interpreting everything I say.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Comfortable silence, then. We always did that well. I'll order so you can stay quiet.

reason: Build an actual mistaken imitation into the shared activity, preserving distinct competitive-care, hopeful-connection, warm-resentment, emotional-pricing, and self-serving-repair tactics.
